text:
Maya Chen: Quick async status — canary for the continuous-batching sprint is showing a p95 tail increase (~+120ms) after kernel PR #482 merged. Repro on canary-3. Spikes line up with KV eviction bursts. @Alex R @Samir Patel can you triage?

Alex R: saw it too. baseline p95 was ~85ms, jumped to ~205ms after the merge. I pulled a flamegraph, looks like a lock churn in kernel hotpath.

Samir Patel: adding details — eviction counter jumps when seq_len > 256 and when prefix cache miss rate > 18%. Might be interaction between eviction policy and continuous-batching window.

Jing Li: repro steps I used: run the canary load with mix: 60% short (<=64), 40% 512 token seqs. Command: `./tools/loadgen --env canary-3 --mix 60,40 --seq-dist 64,512 --duration 10m`

Tom Brooks: small FYI — smoke tests failed on the canary after the PR, not full outage but a few timeouts in reranker stage. posting logs snippet:```text
[12:34:11Z] request-id=abc123 timeout waiting for kv-get
[12:34:12Z] kernel: stall detected waiting on lru cleanup
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for ref=pr/482 completed at 2026-03-17T12:30:05Z (status: SUCCESS) :white_check_mark:

Irene Gomez: suggested mitigation — rollback the kernel lock change on canary and re-run canary tests, or temporarily bump eviction threshold to avoid churn. We should decide quickly (if this affects hosted latency we need a fast fallback).

Maya Chen: Proposed actions: 1) @Alex R prepare a revert patch for canary (or a patch that adds a lockless fast-path). 2) @Samir adjust eviction threshold and run the same load. 3) @Jing run the loadgen and collect flamegraphs + `kvstats`. Who can own the revert?

Alex R: I can own the revert for canary. Will open a small PR with `git revert --no-commit` and a test plan. ETA 30–45m.

Samir Patel: I'll push a canary config with `eviction_threshold=0.25` (was 0.18) and attach `kvstats` dumps. Running now.

Jing Li: running loadgen now, will upload flamegraph link and `kvstats` to the thread when done.

Tom Brooks: I'll re-run the smoke suite after Alex's revert or Samir's config change. Will ping infra if I see infra-level noise.

ops-bot: Note: canary-3 CPU at 78% during spike window, GPU utilization unchanged. Alert history: 3 evictions in last 5m.

Maya Chen: quick triage note — if lockless fast-path is nontrivial, prefer config bump fallback and schedule kernel refactor in next sprint. We need a clear owner for the long-term fix.

Irene Gomez: volunteer for coordinating follow-up and owning the long-term ticket (will create a cross-team RFC + owners).

Alex R: PR opened: github.com/redwood/pr/489 (revert on canary only, feature-flagged). includes smoke checklist.

Samir Patel: pushed canary config change and `kvstats` snapshot here: https://s3.redwood-internal/canary/176250-kvstats-1.json — initial look shows evictions drop by 60%.

Jing Li: uploaded flamegraph: https://prof.redwood/canary/176250-flame.svg — lock time clearly reduced in revert case. Attaching quick diff of top frames in thread.

Tom Brooks: smoke suite after revert: all tests green except one reranker timeout (flaky). I think revert + config bump looks promising.

Maya Chen: status check — rollout plan for hosted: 1) keep canary paused for 1hr, 2) run extended 30m loadgen with production-like mix, 3) if stable, roll to staging, 4) monitor p95 and eviction meter. Any objections?

Irene Gomez: +1. I'll make the rollout ticket and the monitoring dashboard checklists.

Alex R: merging canary revert now (rollout gated to canary only). tagging @oncall for 1hr watch.

ops-bot: Action item logged: INCIDENT-4763 created by Maya Chen — "Canary p95 regression after kernel PR#482". Priority: P2.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — please add any follow-ups here. After 1hr if green we'll promote to staging. If we see recurrence, we'll reopen investigational kernel refactor and reassign long-term owners. :rocket:
